name: Insert middleware execution pipeline between handler and backend
description: Implement Middleware pipeline chaining in src/middleware.ts and connect between src/handler.ts and src/backend.ts.

inputs.task_prompt: Implement the MiddlewarePipeline in src/middleware.ts. It allows registering Middleware functions of type (ctx: Context, next: () => Promise<void>) => Promise<void>. Update src/handler.ts to route requests through the pipeline before reaching executeBackend in src/backend.ts. Include AuthMiddleware and HeaderMiddleware. All tests in test/middleware.test.ts must pass.

acceptance_criteria: MiddlewarePipeline executes middleware in registration order
Middleware can modify Context before and after next()
If middleware aborts without calling next(), backend is not called
